articles.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
articles.description: Where Muse Spark aimed to be a lightweight model that could perform at low latency, the Wonder models are larger and said to be more capable, with higher benchmark scores and better results on complex tasks like coding.

articles.title: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
